---
title: Contributing
description: Add or improve curriculum while preserving stable IDs, rigor, accessibility, and reproducibility.
page_type: contributing
---

Begin with the repository `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Curriculum structure
is declared in `docs/courses/_catalog.yml`; QMD files are canonical; generated
navigation and notebooks must not be edited by hand.

A lesson contribution should define measurable outcomes, prerequisites and
notation; explain hypotheses and limitations; include complete worked
reasoning; provide manual and computational practice; use accessible topic-
specific checkpoints; and end with a reproducible `fcmath`/SymPy appendix.
